body:
## Context
Resolves #669 and #670.
- #669: `packages/init/lib/scaffold.mjs` writes `railEnforcement: "auto"` into config, which is advisory metadata recording which harness scaffolded the repo while actual enforcement comes from the harness plugin hook and `rails-guard-ci`.
- #670: `COPILOT_SETUP_STEPS` in `packages/init/lib/scaffold.mjs` installs `@adlc/cli` unpinned and declares no `permissions:` block on the `copilot-setup-steps` job.

## Acceptance Criteria
1. `packages/init/README.md` and `packages/init/bin/adlc-init.mjs` `--help` document that `harnesses.<name>` records which harness scaffolded the repo and `railEnforcement` is advisory metadata.
2. `COPILOT_SETUP_STEPS` in `packages/init/lib/scaffold.mjs` declares `permissions: contents: read` on the `copilot-setup-steps` job and pins `@adlc/cli` to the package version, with assertions in `packages/init/test/scaffold-copilot.test.mjs`.
title: init: document advisory harnesses.<name>.railEnforcement and pin @adlc/cli with permissions in copilot-setup-steps.yml (#669, #670)
